## Shipment review: APPROVED -> SHIPPED

Merged to main as 7660f52f (f3244ad8..7660f52f), pushed to origin.
10 files changed, +267/-35.

Post-merge verification actually run:
- Remote CI on main for 7660f52f: CI, Repo Hygiene, Changesets Version PR, Release -- all four success.
- Pre-push hook re-ran make sanity green on merged main.
- Coverage threshold .ci/coverage-threshold.txt unchanged at 95.

This knot closes the last of the four opened from the lease/sync review. The
ownership story is now complete end to end: leases record an owner (0b4c),
that owner is resolved atomically even on first use under concurrency (this
knot), foreign leases never block sync and never get recovered (0b4c + the
owner-guard fix), pull holds back only locally leased knots instead of
refusing wholesale (0f9c), and a pulled lease reports its real expiry rather
than reading as expired (e045).
